rules.reason: Rule 1: packages/core is the kernel and never depends on a frontend, a lens or an app
Rule 2: frontends depend only on ir, sdk, model and flow, never on the indexer, a lens or an app
Rule 2: lenses depend only on ir, sdk, model and flow, never on the indexer, a frontend or an app
Rule 2: frontend bazel must not depend on a sibling frontend; they meet only through the kernel
Rule 2: frontend cmake must not depend on a sibling frontend; they meet only through the kernel
Rule 2: frontend cpp must not depend on a sibling frontend; they meet only through the kernel
Rule 2: frontend typescript must not depend on a sibling frontend; they meet only through the kernel
Rule 2: lens calls must not depend on a sibling lens; they meet only through the kernel
Rule 2: lens concurrency-map must not depend on a sibling lens; they meet only through the kernel
Rule 2: lens dependencies must not depend on a sibling lens; they meet only through the kernel
Rule 2: lens effects must not depend on a sibling lens; they meet only through the kernel
Rule 2: lens execution must not depend on a sibling lens; they meet only through the kernel
Rule 2: lens flow-complexity must not depend on a sibling lens; they meet only through the kernel
Rule 2: lens lock-order must not depend on a sibling lens; they meet only through the kernel
Rule 5: nothing under packages depends on apps
